prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver one product-grade LANDSCAPE 1672x941 raster design board for the original couples companion app Our World. Two elegant unbranded portrait phones side by side on a softly blurred neutral warm-gray backdrop, both fully visible, upright and equally large, filling 90 percent height. References: image 1 is exact Ayu identity (navy-black tousled hair, thin round glasses, warm calm face, charcoal hoodie) and anime illustration style; image 2 is environment and painterly light quality only; image 3 locks phone presentation and Cinnaglass material. This is NOT a character chooser.
Show focused mobile invitation onboarding, two moments of the same table, seated first-person camera is Xiaoman: cream cable-knit cardigan sleeves and her own hands holding her own cup in foreground inside each phone. Across the same wooden table is a second blue ceramic mug and a single chair. Warm lit lamp at left, softly rainy blue evening city window behind, original luxurious semi-realistic 2D anime CG, fine linework, painterly soft cel shading, warm skin, amber key light against blue rim, shallow depth of field. Exactly zero people across the table in left phone, exactly one Ayu across in right phone. No reflections of people, no duplicate partner.
LEFT phone: first launch; the empty chair is the emotional focal point, second mug waits quietly, warm lamp. Minimal safe-area header only a small off-white back arrow and title "邀请入座". At bottom an elegant frosted neutral Cinnaglass panel with one prominent warm gold rounded button "邀请 TA 入座" and below it delicate readable off-white secondary action "复制邀请链接". No anniversary count, no ongoing relationship statistics, no bottom navigation at this onboarding step.
RIGHT phone: immediately after accepted invitation: Ayu has sat down across the table, half-body view, lower body hidden by table, smiling directly and raising exactly one anatomically correct hand in a warm wave. His other hand rests by his cup. Xiaoman cream knit sleeves clearly present foreground. Near top but not on face a small neutral frosted toast with precise readable text "TA 来了"; no duplicate invitation button. Minimal bottom glass pill contains a tiny chat icon and "说句话吧". No global bottom nav yet.
UI material exactly as reference 3: neutral smoked frosted glass, fine subtle grain, light thin rim, softly rounded corners, off-white typography, warm gold only action. No neon, no glowing affordance rings or outlines, no pin markers. Keep all hands anatomically clean, 5 fingers per hand, clear faces and glasses. All displayed copy short Simplified Chinese as specified, clean typeset appearance. Scene is hero, UI at edges. No outer caption, logos, branding, watermark. The final board must clearly communicate empty chair to real invited person seated, without AI-character implications.

Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver one product-grade LANDSCAPE 1672x941 design board, two large unbranded portrait phones side by side on soft neutral warm-gray background, fronts fully visible, upright, same size. This is "声音名片" mobile recording for the original real-person companion app Our World. Reference 1 is exact OWN AVATAR identity Ayu: navy-black tousled hair, thin round glasses, charcoal hoodie, calm warm anime male mid twenties. References 2 and 3 establish exact high-end anime CG quality, warm lamp / cool rainy window palette, neutral Cinnaglass frosted material. No chibi, no photoreal character, no existing IP. The user is recording HIS OWN actual voice and previewing HIS OWN avatar; explicitly make this distinction clear with short text "我的声音" next to or below the preview. This is a focused task UI; do not put a partner across a table here.
Both screens: safe top header with off-white back arrow, title "声音名片". Top third shows Ayu's own half-body avatar in a contained rounded preview stage backed by his softly blurred rainy blue window and warm table lamp. He's wearing charcoal hoodie and round glasses identical to reference 1. Fine hair highlights, original clean linework, semi-realistic anime proportions, warm subsurface skin, amber light and cool rim.
LEFT phone: avatar preview has closed relaxed mouth and below it small subtitle "我的声音". Middle/bottom is one continuous Cinnaglass shell with warm opaque reading lining and four generous separated rows, exact labels in this order: "早安" then "戳我干嘛" then "想你了" then "晚安". Only first TWO rows show small gold done checkmarks, a play icon and tiny waveform; last TWO have a simple microphone icon and no check. A small unobtrusive footer "已录 2/4". Clear hierarchy, large readable text. No synthetic voice choices, no cloned voice wording.
RIGHT phone: same own-avatar preview with mouth visibly slightly open as it lip-syncs the real live line. Under preview short label "我的声音". Current line large and precise "想你了". Below it a thin LIVE waveform in warm gold and short timer "00:03". Bottom contains a large solid warm gold circular microphone RECORD button, a clearly illustrated foreground fingertip from a charcoal-hoodie sleeve is physically pressing its center. The hand enters from lower right without covering waveform or important labels; clean anatomy, one hand only. Add short readable instruction "按住录音". This is current recording state, no completion/success message.
Exact UI material: neutral frosted glass, soft blur, fine grain, thin light rim, rounded corners, off-white iconography and typography, restrained warm gold active state. The circular record button is a flat solid control, no glowing ring or halo. No anniversary card or global nav on focused recording. No extra characters, reflections, floating ornament text, captions outside devices, watermarks or real OS logos. Both phone content and skin remain recognizable as same product as references.

Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver a product-grade PORTRAIT image 1024x1536 or largest supported portrait, with ONE centered full unbranded portrait phone on soft warm-gray subtly blurred backdrop. Phone occupies 92 percent of image height. Design the focused full mobile chat screen of original couples companion app Our World. Reference image 1 locks EXACT partner Xiaoman identity: chestnut shoulder-length softly tousled hair, wispy bangs, single tiny gold star hair clip, warm amber eyes, cream cable-knit cardigan over white tee, thin gold necklace. Reference 2 locks mobile phone framing, Cinnaglass UI, anime illustration quality. Reference 3 provides only Ayu viewer identity; do NOT draw Ayu's face.
Top small safe-area header: off-white back chevron, partner label "小满", tiny "在线", simple overflow dots. Top 43 percent of usable phone screen is partner half-body at the table. First-person seated camera belongs to Ayu, charcoal hoodie sleeves and hands with ceramic mug just visible at bottom foreground of the illustrated scene. Exactly one Xiaoman across table, lower body hidden by table, holding an open small unlettered book and gently smiling as she glances down towards the latest message; warm attentive expression, correct anatomy, face unobstructed. Warm amber lamp at left, cool blue rainy city window behind, luxurious original semi-realistic 2D anime CG, fine line art, soft cel and painterly gradients, cinematic light, skin warmth, detailed hair highlights. No second human reflections.
Lower 57 percent: one continuous neutral smoked Cinnaglass conversation shell with softly opaque warm reading lining, thin light rim, subtle blur and fine grain; legible high contrast short Chinese chat text, refined bubbles with ample spacing. Show exactly these four messages plus one sticker in a natural conversation: left received "今天也辛苦啦" in off-white bubble; right sent "有你陪着真好" in subdued warm-gold-tinted bubble; left received voice-message bubble with play triangle, realistic waveform and "0:08"; right a small original hand-drawn steaming mug with a tiny heart sticker (no IP, no words); final left message "一起听首歌吧". The partner view remains visible above.
Bottom fixed input bar matches reference 2: mic button at left, rounded text field "说点什么", clear small smile/sticker button, and warm gold paper-plane send icon at right. All icons readable at phone scale, generous touch targets, home indicator safe zone. Focused chat has NO five-tab global navigation, no music mini-player, no anniversary clutter. Short simplified Chinese labels exactly as specified, no garbled text or long paragraphs. No glowing rings or pins on objects, no neon. No OS branding, no decorative outer titles, no watermark.
